# UI — visual direction, tokens, routes

## Direction

Dark, high-contrast product app. The reference points are Linear and Superhuman:
dense, quiet, keyboard-forward, no chrome that isn't doing work. The mockup at
`/ui-mockup.html` is the source of truth for what this looks like — build the
tokens below to match it, not the other way round.

Optimised equally for two contexts: an associate logging on a phone between
calls, and an SMD scanning a roster on a laptop. Both get the same visual system.

What produces the look, in order of impact:

1. **Near-black ground with layered panels.** `#08090A` canvas, `#141518` panels,
   `#1A1B1F` for raised or hovered surfaces. Depth comes from these three steps,
   not from shadows.
2. **Borders are white at low alpha, never grey hex.** `rgba(255,255,255,.065)`
   sits correctly on every surface; a fixed grey bands visibly when layered.
3. **Text never hits pure white.** `#EDEEF0` is the ceiling. Pure white on
   near-black is the fastest way to make a dark UI feel cheap.
4. **One accent, used sparingly.** Electric blue `#3D9AFF` for primary action,
   active nav, selected state, links, and the activity matrix. Nothing else.
5. **A one-pixel top highlight on raised surfaces** — `inset 0 1px 0
   rgba(255,255,255,.04)`. Cards, buttons, chips. Subtle, and it is most of what
   makes elements feel physical rather than painted on.
6. **Tight type.** 13px base, `-.006em` tracking on body, `-.025em` on headings,
   weights capped at 600. Numbers in mono at weight 500 with heavy negative
   tracking (`-.045em`) — thin and wide, not chunky.
7. **Small radii.** 6px controls, 8px cards, 12px only on the mobile primary
   button. Pills reserved for chips and badges.

## Tokens

```css
:root{
  /* ground */
  --bg:#08090A; --bg-2:#0E0F11; --panel:#141518; --panel-2:#1A1B1F;
  --hover:#1F2024; --sunken:#0B0C0D;
  /* hairlines — alpha, never hex */
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.065); --line-2:rgba(255,255,255,.11);
  --line-3:rgba(255,255,255,.18);
  /* text */
  --fg:#EDEEF0; --fg-2:#9CA0A8; --fg-3:#666A73; --fg-4:#4A4D55;
  /* accent */
  --acc:#3D9AFF; --acc-2:#7FBBFF; --acc-dim:rgba(61,154,255,.13);
  --acc-line:rgba(61,154,255,.32);
  /* attainment only */
  --ok:#3FB950; --warn:#D29922; --bad:#F85149;
  --warn-dim:rgba(210,153,34,.13); --bad-dim:rgba(248,81,73,.13);
  /* form */
  --r:8px; --r-sm:6px; --r-lg:12px;
  --lift:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.04);
  --ui:'Inter',-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,monospace;
}
```

Map into `tailwind.config.ts` so utilities and components share one source of
truth. **Dark is the only theme in v1** — do not build a light mode, and do not
add a theme toggle. If it is ever needed, the token layer makes it additive.

**Green, amber, and red mean target attainment and nothing else** — ≥100%,
70–99%, <70%. A call-outcome badge uses neutral or accent tints. Colouring
"Voicemail" red makes the roster unscannable and implies a failure that isn't one.

**The activity matrix is the signature element.** Cells that hit the daily
minimum are solid accent with a soft outer glow; partial days are accent at 10%
and 24% alpha; zero days sink to `--sunken` with a hairline; future days are a
dashed outline. On this ground the gaps are what the eye lands on first, which is
exactly the finding an SMD needs. Do not flatten this into a plain table.

## Accessibility on dark

- Body text `--fg` on `--panel` clears AA comfortably; `--fg-3` is for
  non-essential secondary text only — never for a value a user must read.
- Focus ring is a two-layer box-shadow (`--bg` then `--acc`) so it reads on any
  surface. Never remove the outline without replacing it.
- Touch targets ≥44px on mobile even where the visual control is 32px.
- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## Component library
shadcn/ui (Button, Card, Table, Dialog, Sheet, Select, Tabs, Badge, Toast,
Skeleton, DropdownMenu, Form, **Popover + Calendar** for date ranges,
**Command** for the searchable agent multi-select, Checkbox), restyled against
the tokens above. shadcn ships light-first — restyle each component to the dark
tokens as you add it rather than layering a dark override on top, or you will be
chasing contrast bugs for the rest of the build.
Charts: Recharts — line, bar, **horizontal bar**, and **Pie with `innerRadius`**
for the donuts in `docs/08-screen-specs.md`. Chart grid lines and axes use
`--line`; series use `--acc` and `--acc-2`; the "zero" series uses `--fg-4`.
Add no other chart library without asking.

## Routes

Terminology, used consistently across all docs: **SMD** = the person, `leader` =
their role value, **upline** = the hierarchy relationship. They are the same
human in v1; do not invent a fourth word.

Targets live on `/team/targets`, SMD-only. One card reproducing the workbook's
gold cells (Calls Target/Wk, Appts Held Target/Wk, Premium Target/Wk, Min
Calls/Day, MD Deadline) with the same defaults 50 / 3 / $188 / 15 as the org
default, plus a per-agent override table. Saving shows an inline note that the
change applies from the coming Monday and that past weeks keep their original
target. Agents see the same card in `/settings`, read-only, with "set by your
SMD" attribution.

**Associate**
| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `/today` | **default landing** — the callback queue |
| `/log` | quick log |
| `/dashboard` | week/8-week view of own numbers |
| `/contacts` | people, not call rows; drill into one contact's history |
| `/appointments`, `/sales`, `/recruiting` | list + edit |
| `/import` | one-time spreadsheet upload |
| `/settings` | profile, read-only targets card, data export, delete account |

**Leader** (`/team/*`, guarded by role + hierarchy)
| Route | Notes |
|---|---|
| `/team` | roster: the core screen |
| `/team/[agentId]` | aggregate drill-down, 8-week trend, funnel |
| `/team/[agentId]/daily` | day-by-day grid for one agent over a date range |
| `/team/targets` | org default + per-agent overrides |
| `/team/invites` | send/revoke invitations |

**Auth, profile, settings, invitations, admin, and the navigation shell** are
specified in `docs/09-account-and-auth.md`. **Journeys and empty states** in
`docs/10-journeys.md`.

## The two screens that matter

### `/log` — quick log (mobile-first, thumb zone)
One screen, no navigation, no modal stack:
1. Contact name — text input, autocompletes from the agent's own prior contacts
2. Source — 6 chips, single select, last-used pre-selected
3. Outcome — 5 chips, single select
4. Save — full-width, bottom of screen, thumb-reachable

Optional (collapsed): company, notes. `Appointment Set` reveals an inline date
picker and creates the appointment row in the same submit.

Two additions that carry the whole product:
- **Call back on…** — appears on any outcome except `Not interested`, as chips:
  *Tomorrow · Monday · Next week · 1 month · Pick a date*. One tap. This field
  populates `/today` and is the reason the agent opens the app tomorrow.
- **Date chip at the top** reading *Today*, tapping opens a picker. Agents batch-log
  at 8 PM; a form that only accepts same-day entry is abandoned in week two.

Requirements: optimistic insert, toast with Undo, form resets to step 1 with
source retained, counter at top reading `7 / 15 today · 3-day streak`.
**Target: five taps, no page transition.** Offline: queue in IndexedDB, flush on
reconnect. Ship as a PWA so it installs to the home screen.

### `/team` — roster table
Dense table, one row per downline agent, default sort **% to calls goal ascending**
(worst first — this is a coaching queue, not a leaderboard):

`Agent · Calls (n/target, bar) · Appts Set · Appts Held · Premium ·
Streak · Last logged`

Show the absolute number and the target together (`37 / 50`), not a bare
percentage — the raw count is what a coaching conversation actually uses.
Agents on a per-agent override get a small marker so the SMD remembers the
denominator differs.

- Row colour band by attainment; `Last logged > 7d` gets a muted "quiet" badge
- Sort by any column; default sort is % to goal ascending (worst first — this is
  a coaching queue, not a leaderboard)
- Filters, the agent multi-select, the Summary/Daily toggle, the team KPI strip,
  and the charts are all specified in `docs/08-screen-specs.md` — that file is
  authoritative for this screen's contents; this section covers only the table.
- Mobile: collapses to cards, name + calls bar + last-logged
- Empty state names the reason ("No one in your downline yet — invite someone")

## Rules
- Server Components render data; client components handle input only.
- Every list has loading skeleton, empty state, and error state. No spinners on
  full pages.
- Numbers right-aligned, mono, tabular-nums. Currency at the edge, never in DB.
- Dates always `Mon 11 Aug` or ISO — never `08/11`, which is ambiguous in Canada.
- Touch targets `>=44px`. Contrast AA. Every interactive element keyboard-reachable
  and labelled. Charts carry a data table fallback for screen readers.
- `⌘K` opens a command palette scoped to the agent's own contacts. Desktop only;
  it is a convenience, never the only path to anything.
- No dark-pattern gamification. Streaks are informational; do not shame.
